decisions.statement: A path under a page name is moved by the change moving the files beside it.
Every other TypeScript path is moved by the change judging the imports named.
Every other path is moved by the change moving the file alone.
The kind of path is read off the path the file is moved from.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.
Nothing here reads a path for its kind.
A path under a page type name is moved by the change moving a page type.
A path under a page property name is moved by the change moving a page property.

definition: one file moved to another path, through the change moving that kind of path
